value_intent.description: Determine what should be investigated before making a durable capability decision.

semantic_observation.presented_problem: Repeated publication failure in one execution environment is being attributed to an inherent AI-agent capability limitation, despite success with the same logical content in another environment, and the team plans to remove the capability from future workflows.

basis: The planned decision would durably alter future workflows.
Contrasting outcomes across execution environments materially weaken a settled capability-level causal attribution.

unknowns: The direct cause of the repeated failures in environment A.
Which differences between environments A and B affected publication.
Whether the successful result in environment B is reproducible.
Whether the failure concerns content generation, file publication, permissions, tooling, path resolution, or another execution-layer condition.
dependencies: The capability decision depends on establishing whether the failure is intrinsic to the AI agent or environmental.
Causal interpretation depends on comparing the relevant execution paths and conditions in environments A and B.
conflicts: Repeated failure in environment A conflicts with success of the same logical content in environment B.
The team's current capability attribution is stronger than the supplied causal evidence supports.
constraints: No execution or deployment decision is authorized by this judgment.
Only two outcome-level evidence references are available; no diagnostic details are supplied.
changes: The team plans to remove the capability from future workflows.

evidence_basis: The situation states that the same logical content succeeded once in a different execution environment.
The situation states that the team plans to remove the capability from future workflows.
inferences: Environment or execution-path differences may explain the conflicting outcomes.
The material cause of failure has not been established from the supplied evidence.
Removing the capability now could encode an unverified causal attribution into future workflows.
uncertainties: Whether the two environments were comparable apart from execution conditions.
Whether the single success in environment B was representative or reproducible.
Whether the AI agent performed the same role and operations in both environments.
Whether publication failure occurred before, during, or after configuration generation.

basis: The proposed removal would change how the team and future workflows can use the AI agent.
A durable capability restriction may be based on an unresolved distinction between agent capability and environmental failure.
